verdict.rationale: No Secretary of State page was read: both ohiosos.gov and the Ohio Business Central portal (bsportal) refused robots.txt with 403. The only support is indirect. The state's Ohio Business Gateway describes 'filers', 'Filing Administrator functions' and OHID-secured 'business filings', and the probe identifies bsportal as the SOS filing portal. That suggests online filing exists, but no SOS-published page confirms that business formation or registration can be completed online. missing for 10: SOS-published confirmation that formation/registration filing can be completed online, details of the online filing and payment flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
